data.title: Lori Esposito gave Lulu and Georgia 3 stars. Check out the full review...
data.content:
* * *

## [A little disappointed](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/642b29eb746ca7dfea0262a2)
Placed an order. Received one item from order, it was damaged. Customer service was great. Exchanged the item, still haven't received the rest of the original order but replacement item came.... damaged. Just reached our to customer service for round two. Can't say I love spending my time on things like these.

Update. I ordered a few different items. A few days later I told friend about the items I ordered, she then placed the same order. Her items came 2 days ago. I'm still waiting. I just received email saying one of my items is out of stock! Glad she got hers afyer placing her order afyer mine :(

March 26, 2023

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Apr 4, 2023

Hi Lori,

We thank you for reaching out and we're sorry to hear the replacement arrived damaged as well. A full refund has been issued per your request and your other items will be delivered tomorrow by end of the day. If you have any further questions or concerns, please reach out to support@luluandgeorgia.com.
